classes.name: ToolCall
classes.description: Tracks details of tool calls made by the Orchestrator, including name, arguments, output, success status, and reasoning. Integrates with logging for monitoring and debugging tool execution.

classes.name: ToolUsageStats
classes.description: Tracks tool usage statistics during orchestration, including web search, file reading, code searching, and test running limits. Integrates with orchestration logic to enforce usage caps via configurable maximum call limits.

classes.name: OrchestratorResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an orchestration process, containing analysis, instructions for code generation, tool calls, and target files. Integrates with tool usage tracking and supports multiple target files for modification.

classes.name: UserFile
classes.description: Represents a file uploaded by a user with attributes for filename, content, token count, and file type. Integrates with file processing workflows in the orchestrator system.

classes.name: GeneralChatResult
classes.description: Represents the result of the General Chat Orchestrator, containing the final response, tool calls, raw response, and optional tool usage statistics. Integrates with tool call handling and logging for tracking execution details.

classes.name: GeneralChatOrchestrator
classes.description: Orchestrates general chat interactions using user files and web search, supporting up to 15 web searches and 25 iterations with dynamic tool usage tracking. Integrates with LLMs via tool calling, includes legal mode with specialized prompts, and handles error recovery and Claude-specific optimizations.

classes.name: PreFilterMode
classes.description: Defines operating modes for a pre-filter agent, distinguishing between normal mode (basic analysis) and advanced mode (with tool access). Integrates with logging for monitoring and uses regex for pattern matching in filtering logic.

classes.name: PreFilterAdvice
classes.description: Stores the analysis results from a pre-filter agent, including clarified queries, diagnostic insights, recommended actions, and metadata about tool usage. Integrates with logging and JSON for structured output and debugging.

classes.name: SelectedChunk
classes.description: Represents a selected code chunk with metadata such as ID, file path, type, relevance score, and source code lines. Integrates with preprocessing pipelines to support filtering and analysis of code segments.

classes.name: PreFilterResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a pre-filtering operation, containing selected chunks, token counts, and pruning statistics. Integrates with chunk selection and token counting logic for efficient data filtering.

classes.name: RouteResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a routing decision with details on the selected orchestrator model, complexity, reasoning, confidence, risk level, and whether automatic routing was applied. Integrates with routing logic to support dynamic workflow selection based on defined criteria.

classes.name: AnalyzerModel
classes.description: Defines an enumeration for selecting analyzer models such as Qwen and DeepSeek, used to specify which model to employ in text analysis tasks. Integrates with semantic indexing workflows through model selection and configuration.

classes.name: AnalysisError
classes.description: Represents a custom exception for handling errors during code analysis, used to signal issues in the semantic index building process. Integrates with the semantic_index_builder module for robust error management in code processing workflows.

classes.name: ImportInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata for imported modules including source lines, module names, and token count. Used in semantic indexing to track import dependencies and analyze code structure.

classes.name: GlobalsInfo
classes.description: Stores global information for semantic indexing including source code lines, variable/function names, and token count. Used to track and process code elements during index construction.

classes.name: ClassInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata and analysis results for a class, including name, source lines, token count, content hash, and references. Integrates with semantic analysis tools to track documentation and method usage.

classes.name: FunctionInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata and analysis results for functions, including name, source lines, token count, content hash, analysis tool, description, and referenced entities. Designed to support semantic indexing and codebase analysis workflows.

classes.name: FileIndex
classes.description: Represents a file's metadata and parsed content for semantic indexing, including path, hash, token count, imports, globals, and structural elements like classes and functions. Integrates with asynchronous processing and hashing for efficient file tracking and updates.

classes.name: IndexStats
classes.description: Tracks detailed statistics for semantic indexing operations, including API call counts, success/failure rates, file processing metrics, and error logs. Integrates with Qwen and DeepSeek LLMs for content analysis and fallback handling.

classes.name: ContentHasher
classes.description: Generates consistent MD5 hashes for files, raw content, and code blocks to enable efficient deduplication and content comparison. Integrates with file system operations and string normalization for reliable hashing across different input types.

classes.name: ResponseParser
classes.description: Parses and cleans AI-generated responses by removing thinking blocks, markdown, prefixes, and irrelevant content, then extracts the first meaningful output. Integrates with IndexStats for tracking parsing recoveries and validates output quality to ensure concise, relevant results.

classes.name: AIClient
classes.description: Handles AI-powered code analysis with fallback mechanisms between Qwen and DeepSeek models, integrating token counting, response parsing, and comprehensive error tracking. Uses async concurrency control and provider-aware model selection for robust, scalable semantic analysis.

classes.name: ReferenceExtractor
classes.description: Extracts function and method references from Python code using AST parsing and regex fallback, filtering out built-in identifiers. Integrates with semantic indexing by identifying user-defined function calls and attribute accesses.

classes.name: AsyncFileProcessor
classes.description: Processes files asynchronously with a limit of 25 concurrent tasks using a semaphore, supporting progress tracking and error handling. Integrates with async file reading via aiofiles and enables batch processing through configurable callback functions.

classes.name: ParallelChunkProcessor
classes.description: Processes Python file chunking in parallel using thread pools for I/O-bound operations, integrating with SmartPythonChunker to convert files into structured trees. Designed for efficient, scalable parsing of multiple source files with error handling and progress tracking.

classes.name: SemanticIndexer
classes.description: Incrementally indexes code files across multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java) from any directory, generating detailed semantic metadata and maintaining a compressed, updatable index. Integrates with AI analysis, file hashing, and parallel processing for efficient, scalable codebase understanding.

classes.name: IndexFileWatcher
classes.description: Monitors file system changes in a project directory to trigger automatic updates to a semantic index, supporting multiple programming languages through watchdog. Processes file additions, modifications, and deletions with debouncing and batching, integrating with a SemanticIndexer for real-time index synchronization.

classes.name: APIProvider
classes.description: Defines an enumeration of available API providers with their respective string identifiers, used to standardize provider selection in API client implementations. Integrates with async HTTP handling via asyncio and logging for monitoring API interactions.

classes.name: LLMResponse
classes.description: Represents a standardized response from an LLM with fields for content, metadata, token counts, cost, latency, tool calls, and additional provider-specific fields like reasoning content, thought signatures, and reasoning details. Includes a finish_reason field to diagnose response truncation, supporting compatibility across multiple LLM providers.

classes.name: LLMRequest
classes.description: Represents a standardized request structure for calling large language models with configurable parameters like model, temperature, and token limits. Integrates with async API clients and supports optional tools and dynamic temperature settings for reasoning models.

classes.name: ModelRouter
classes.description: Routes model names to their corresponding API providers and endpoints using centralized configuration, with fallback logic for missing API keys. Integrates with settings.py for provider and model configuration, and handles dynamic provider resolution and default fallbacks.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: Universal LLM client supporting multiple providers with automatic routing, retry logic, rate limiting, and tool/function calling, integrating with OpenAI SDK and custom model configurations. Handles extended thinking for Claude models, logs requests/responses, and tracks usage statistics including token counts and costs.

classes.name: LLMAPIError
classes.description: Base exception class for handling errors from LLM API calls, with support for categorizing errors by type. Integrates with logging for error tracking and includes a timestamp for debugging.

classes.name: RateLimitError

functions.name: _format_test_run_limit_error
functions.description: Formats an error message when the test run limit is exceeded, including the current count and maximum allowed runs. Integrates with tool usage statistics and uses CDATA to preserve formatting in the XML output.

functions.name: _process_file_tools_with_batch_limit
functions.description: Processes tool calls with a token limit for file-reading tools, executing them until the batch limit is reached and returning a message to call large files separately, while preserving non-file tools; integrates with TokenCounter for token tracking and ToolUsageStats for rate limiting.

functions.name: _format_batch_limit_skip_message
functions.description: Formats a structured message indicating a file was skipped due to reaching the batch token limit, instructing the model to retry in a subsequent call. Integrates with the orchestrator's batching logic to manage token usage across file reads.

functions.name: _should_use_batch_limit
functions.description: Determines whether a given model should use a batch file token limit based on predefined models with limited context. Integrates with configuration constants to check against models like Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek Reasoner, and Qwen 3.7 Max.

functions.name: orchestrate_new_project
functions.description: Orchestrates the creation of new projects from scratch using a limited set of tools, primarily web_search, with adaptive prompting and forced finalization if no instruction section is detected. Integrates with LLMs, tool executors, and logging to manage iterative planning and response generation.

functions.name: _has_instruction_section
functions.description: Checks if a given response contains an instruction section using multiple pattern matches for various language and formatting variations. Integrates with regex patterns to detect structured task or file directives in the response content.

functions.name: _get_available_tools
functions.description: Filters and returns a list of available tools based on current usage limits, excluding tools that have reached their quotas. Integrates with ToolUsageStats to check limits for web_search and run_project_tests.

functions.name: _format_web_search_limit_error
functions.description: Formats an error message when the web_search API limit is reached, including usage statistics and guidance on alternative tools. Integrates with tool usage tracking via the ToolUsageStats dataclass.

functions.name: _format_chunks_for_context
functions.description: Formats a list of selected code chunks into a structured text context for the Orchestrator, including metadata like file path, line numbers, relevance score, and code content. Integrates with SelectedChunk dataclass to extract and present relevant code snippets in a readable, markdown-formatted string.

functions.name: _format_chunks_as_initial_context_message
functions.description: Formats a list of selected code chunks into a structured user message for initial context, including metadata and code snippets. Returns the formatted message as a dictionary or None if no chunks are provided.

functions.name: _remove_chunks_message_from_history
functions.description: Removes the pre-filtered code chunks message from the conversation history to optimize token usage after the first tool call. Identifies the message by the "PRE-FILTERED CODE CHUNKS" marker in the user's content.

functions.name: _parse_orchestrator_response
functions.description: Parses structured Orchestrator responses to extract analysis, instructions, and target Python files using multiple regex patterns with fallbacks for robustness. Integrates logging for debugging and supports both English and Russian section headers.

functions.name: _looks_like_instruction
functions.description: Determines if a given text contains actionable instructions by checking for specific markers, code patterns, or structured content. Integrates regex and keyword matching to identify tasks, code snippets, or directives in both English and Russian.

functions.name: _validate_instruction_format
functions.description: Validates that an instruction string follows the expected format with required headers and structure, checking for essential elements like SCOPE/Task, file specification, and action blocks. Returns a boolean indicating validity and a list of any issues found.

functions.name: _optimize_cache_by_size
functions.description: Optimizes cache usage by retaining only the top-N largest blocks with cache_control enabled, discarding cache flags from smaller blocks to conserve resources. Integrates with logging to track cache optimization actions.

functions.name: orchestrate_agent
functions.description: Orchestrates agent-based interactions with adaptive context compression, tool execution, and dynamic prompt management for code-related tasks. Integrates with LLMs, tool executors, and project indexing systems while handling context overflow and batch file limits.

functions.name: _find_prefilter_project_python
functions.description: Finds and returns the path to a Python executable inside a virtual environment within a given project directory, checking standard venv directory names. Integrates with the OS-specific path structure (Windows vs. Unix-like) to locate the correct Python binary.

functions.name: _prefilter_missing_project_python_xml
functions.description: Generates a default XML configuration for a Python project environment when no local Python environment is detected, indicating the absence of a local Python setup. Integrates with project directory path and includes a message explaining the pre-filter's behavior.

functions.name: _extract_language_block
functions.description: Extracts a specific language block from an XML string based on the provided language name, returning the full XML block or a blank one if not found. Uses regex pattern matching with escaping for safe string comparison.

functions.name: _execute_prefilter_list_installed_packages
functions.description: Lists installed packages for a project's isolated environment, prioritizing a virtual environment within the project directory to avoid confusion with global or system environments. Supports multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, Go, Java) and returns XML-formatted output, with fallbacks to inspect non-Python environments when no project-specific Python is found.

functions.name: _execute_prefilter_tool
functions.description: Executes a pre-filter tool based on the function name, with special handling for listing installed packages. Delegates to the tool executor for other functions, integrating with project directory context.

functions.name: _get_prefilter_analysis_system_prompt
functions.description: Generates a system prompt for pre-filter analysis based on the specified mode and planning context. Integrates with internal prompt-building functions to return appropriate prompts for normal, advanced, or planning-specific scenarios.

functions.name: _get_prefilter_analysis_user_prompt
functions.description: Generates a formatted user prompt for pre-filter analysis by incorporating the user query, project map, and compact index into a predefined template. Handles missing context by substituting placeholders with default messages.

functions.name: _parse_prefilter_advice
functions.description: Parses a raw pre-filter response string into a structured PreFilterAdvice object by extracting fields based on section headers and list items. Integrates with logging for debugging and uses regex-like string matching to identify and categorize response content.

functions.name: analyze_query
functions.description: Analyzes a user query using a language model to generate recommendations for the Orchestrator, supporting both normal and advanced modes with optional tool calls and planning. functions.name: _run_advanced_prefilter

functions.name: extract_plan
functions.description: Extracts a plan from an LLM response using the "###Plan#####" markers, with fallback logic to treat the entire response as the plan if markers are missing or incomplete. Integrates with logging for debugging and error tracking.

functions.name: run_planning_loop
functions.description: Executes an advanced planning loop using LLM-driven tool calls with graceful degradation, dynamically selecting models and handling tool execution with real-time callbacks. functions.name: pre_filter_chunks

functions.name: _load_all_chunks_with_code
functions.description: Loads all code chunks from either a compressed or regular semantic index, retrieving source code from original files using line numbers. Integrates with TokenCounter to track token usage during chunk loading.

functions.name: _load_from_regular_index

functions.name: _call_prefilter_llm

functions.name: _format_chunks_with_code
functions.description: Formats a list of code chunks with detailed metadata and source code for LLM consumption, using a structured delimiter-based layout. Integrates with SelectedChunk objects to extract and present file paths, line ranges, types, and code content.

functions.name: _get_prefilter_system_prompt
functions.description: Generates a system prompt for a pre-filter LLM to select the most relevant code chunks based on a user's query, with strict JSON output requirements and Russian-language reasoning. functions.name: _get_prefilter_user_prompt
functions.description: Generates a structured prompt for a pre-filter LLM to select the most relevant code chunks based on a user query, project map, and available code snippets. Integrates with code analysis workflows by emphasizing the use of actual code content for decision-making.

functions.name: _parse_prefilter_response
functions.description: Parses a pre-filter LLM response by extracting and validating JSON content, falling back to regex-based extraction if JSON parsing fails. Integrates with logging for error tracking and uses helper functions for JSON cleaning, chunk normalization, and fallback parsing.

functions.name: _extract_json_from_response
functions.description: Extracts a JSON string from an LLM response by first checking for JSON within markdown code blocks, then using brace matching to find a valid JSON object starting with '{', ensuring it contains the key "selected_chunks". functions.name: _extract_by_brace_matching
functions.description: Extracts a JSON string from text starting at a given index by matching opening and closing braces, handling escaped characters and string literals. Integrates with text parsing logic in pre_filter.py for structured data extraction.

functions.name: _clean_json_string
functions.description: Removes trailing commas before closing braces or brackets and strips zero-width characters and whitespace from JSON strings. Used to sanitize malformed JSON input before parsing.

functions.name: _normalize_chunks
functions.description: Normalizes chunk data by extracting and validating chunk_id, relevance_score, and reason fields, ensuring consistent structure and score bounds. Limits results to max_chunks and sorts them in descending order by relevance score.

functions.name: _try_regex_extraction
functions.description: Attempts to extract structured chunk data from a response string using a regex pattern, returning up to max_chunks results with chunk_id, relevance_score, and reason. Falls back to parsing JSON-like structures when direct extraction is needed.

functions.name: _get_selected_chunks
functions.description: Filters and sorts chunks based on provided IDs while preserving and updating their relevance scores and reasoning from LLM assessments. Integrates with chunk data structures to maintain ranking order by relevance.

functions.name: _apply_token_limit
functions.description: Trims a list of text chunks by removing the lowest relevance chunks until the total token count is within a specified limit, preserving whole chunks only. Integrates with logging to track pruned chunks and token reductions.

functions.name: _fallback_selection

functions.name: _empty_result

functions.name: _build_router_user_prompt

functions.name: _get_model_for_complexity

functions.name: general_web_search_tool

functions.name: general_web_search_tool_sync
functions.description: Provides a synchronous alias for the general_web_search_tool function for backward compatibility.

functions.name: async_general_web_search
functions.description: Performs an asynchronous general web search using DuckDuckGo, fetches and ranks relevant pages, and selects results within a token limit. Integrates with parallel fetching, relevance scoring, and token-based result trimming.

functions.name: duckduckgo_search
functions.description: Performs asynchronous web searches using DuckDuckGo via HTTP POST requests, supporting region and time-based filtering, and returns parsed search results as a list of dictionaries.

functions.name: parse_ddg_html
functions.description: Parses HTML search results from DuckDuckGo, extracting URLs, titles, and snippets into a structured list of dictionaries. Uses regex for parsing and includes URL validation and HTML tag cleaning.

functions.name: remove_html_tags
functions.description: Removes HTML tags from a given string using regular expressions.

functions.name: extract_actual_url
functions.description: Extracts the actual URL from a DuckDuckGo search redirect link by parsing the uddg parameter, returning the decoded URL if found or the original if not.

functions.name: is_valid_url
functions.description: Validates if a given string is a well-formed URL and not pointing to common document or archive file types.

functions.name: fetch_pages_parallel
functions.description: Fetches web pages in parallel from search results using asyncio, filters out empty or errored pages, and returns up to the specified maximum number of valid pages.

functions.name: fetch_single_page
functions.description: Fetches and processes the content of a single web page, truncating it if it exceeds a token limit, and returns a GeneralWebPage object with the results.

functions.name: fetch_page_content
functions.description: Fetches and extracts text content from a webpage asynchronously using HTTPX, with custom headers and timeout; returns empty string on failure.

functions.name: extract_text_from_html
functions.description: Extracts and cleans text from HTML by removing specific tags and unnecessary whitespace, while preserving line breaks and decoding HTML entities.

functions.name: truncate_content
functions.description: Performs binary search to truncate text content precisely within a token limit using a provided token counter. Used to ensure content fits within a specified token budget for tasks like prompt engineering or API input preparation.

functions.name: calculate_relevance_scores
functions.description: Calculates relevance scores for web pages based on Jaccard similarity between query and page title, snippet, and content preview. Assigns weighted scores to each component and returns the updated pages.

functions.name: select_within_token_limit
functions.description: Selects web pages whose total token count does not exceed the given limit, truncating the last page if necessary to stay within the limit.

functions.name: format_results_xml
functions.description: Formats a GeneralWebSearchResult object into an XML string with query, token count, and paginated results including title, URL, and content.

functions.name: format_error
functions.description: Formats an error message by wrapping it in <error> tags.

functions.name: format_no_results
functions.description: Returns a formatted string indicating no search results were found for the given query.

functions.name: get_staging_error_guidance
functions.description: Provides AI-friendly error guidance for staging errors in code modifications, including descriptions, causes, solutions, and mode hints. Integrates with code analysis tools and file reading utilities to resolve issues like missing entities, syntax errors, and ambiguous patterns.

functions.name: create_runtime_test_feedback
functions.description: Converts a RuntimeTestSummary dictionary into a RuntimeTestFeedback object, categorizing test results by status and extracting project analysis details. Integrates with analysis data to provide insights on project size, detected frameworks, and timeout usage.

functions.name: create_validation_error_feedback
functions.description: Creates a ValidationErrorFeedback object from a validation result, filtering issues by specified level and categorizing them into errors and warnings. Integrates with validation result data to determine blocking status and affected files, returning None if no issues are present.

functions.name: create_test_run_feedback_from_xml
functions.description: Parses XML output from the run_project_tests tool to create a TestRunFeedback object, extracting test results, failures, and metadata. Integrates with XML parsing and regex to extract structured feedback from raw test output.

functions.name: handle_user_validation_action
functions.description: Processes user actions taken in response to validator rejection, routing the feedback appropriately to the Orchestrator based on the chosen action. Integrates with FeedbackHandler for feedback management and supports actions like cancellation, override, critique replacement, or acceptance.

functions.name: create_feedback_loop
functions.description: Creates a new FeedbackLoopState instance with the provided session and request details, including configurable limits for validator retries, orchestrator revisions, and test runs. Integrates with the FeedbackLoopState dataclass to manage iterative refinement of AI-generated outputs.

functions.name: get_validator
functions.description: Returns a globally shared instance of AIValidator, creating it if it doesn't already exist. Integrates with logging for monitoring validation processes.

functions.name: validate_code_change
functions.description: Validates a proposed code change against the original request and context using an AI validator, returning structured validation results and feedback. Integrates with the feedback_handler to generate detailed ValidatorFeedback objects.

functions.name: is_context_overflow_error
functions.description: Detects context overflow errors across multiple AI providers by checking for specific keywords in the error message. Integrates with logging for error tracking and uses regex-like string matching for robust detection.

functions.name: get_compressor
functions.description: Retrieves or creates an IntraSessionCompressor instance for a given model ID, caching it to maintain compression statistics across session calls. Integrates with a global cache dictionary (_compressor_cache) to ensure consistent compressor instances per model.

functions.name: reset_compressor
functions.description: Resets the compressor for a specified model by removing its entry from the compressor cache, effectively starting a new session. Integrates with the global _compressor_cache dictionary to manage model-specific compressor states.

functions.name: reset_all_compressors
functions.description: Resets all cached compressors by clearing the internal compressor cache. Integrates with the global _compressor_cache dictionary to ensure a clean state.

functions.name: maybe_compress_context
functions.description: Compresses a list of messages if required by the target model, using a model-specific compressor. Integrates with the get_compressor function to determine and apply compression dynamically.

functions.name: get_error_code_for_language
functions.description: Maps a language and error type combination to a corresponding validation error code, with fallback to a generic unknown error code. Integrates with ValidationErrorCode enum to standardize error reporting across supported languages.

functions.name: _get_tree_sitter_parser
functions.description: Lazily imports and initializes a Tree-sitter parser with fault tolerance, caching the instance for reuse. Integrates with the app.services.tree_sitter_parser module to handle syntax parsing with fallback support.

functions.name: classify_staging_error
functions.description: Classifies staging error messages into structured error types for actionable feedback, prioritizing ambiguous patterns, targeting issues, integrity failures, and syntax problems. Integrates with the StagingErrorType enum from the feedback handler to enable precise error categorization based on keyword matching and context.

functions.name: init_advice_system
functions.description: Initializes and returns a global AdviceSystem instance, loading advice data from a specified base path.

functions.name: get_advice_system
functions.description: Provides a global instance of the AdviceSystem, initializing it if it doesn't already exist.

functions.name: get_catalog_for_prompt
functions.description: Generates a formatted catalog of advice entries for inclusion in the Orchestrator's system prompt, grouped by category and filtered by mode (ask or new_project). Integrates with the advice system to retrieve and display advice summaries.

functions.name: execute_get_advice
functions.description: Executes the get_advice tool with support for searching by ID, name, or keyword, returning XML-formatted advice content or error messages; integrates with an advice system for query resolution and suggestions.

functions.name: _load_compact_index_md
functions.description: Loads the compact project index from compact_index.md for the Orchestrator, providing a concise map of the project (~3-5k tokens) instead of a full JSON index. Falls back to a placeholder message if the file is missing or unreadable.

functions.name: extract_deletions_from_instruction
functions.description: Extracts deletion instructions for code elements or entire files from a given instruction string, returning a cleaned instruction and a list of PendingDeletion objects. Integrates with TesterAgent and TesterReport for managing deletion tasks in the agent pipeline.

functions.name: parse_response_type
functions.description: Determines the response type (DIRECT_ANSWER or CODE_INSTRUCTION) from an orchestrator's output by analyzing structured headers, code blocks, directives, and contextual cues, with fallbacks based on length and content. Integrates with logging for debugging and relies on regex patterns to reduce false positives.

functions.name: _count_skipped_reasons
functions.description: Counts and categorizes reasons for skipped runtime test files based on message content, grouping similar reasons into standardized categories. Integrates with RuntimeTestSummary data structure to provide a summarized breakdown of skip reasons.

functions.name: download_russia_cert
functions.description: Автоматически загружает сертификат Минцифры по указанному URL, если он отсутствует или повреждён, использует requests для скачивания и сохраняет его в указанную директорию.

functions.name: test_openai_compatible
functions.description: Tests OpenAI-compatible models (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, RouterAI) by sending a philosophical question, returns formatted results with status, latency, and response. Uses requests and logging, integrates with external APIs.

functions.name: test_gigachat_full
functions.description: Тестирует авторизацию и работу GigaChat API, включая получение токена и отправку сообщения, с проверкой SSL-сертификата. Использует requests, логирование и настройки из конфигурации.

functions.name: run_checks
functions.description: Runs a connectivity diagnostic for multiple AI models, testing API responses and logging errors; integrates with OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and GigaChat via configured API keys and endpoints.

functions.name: build_dynamic_import_mapping
functions.description: Builds a dynamic mapping from import names to pip package names by combining fallback mappings with installed package metadata from importlib.metadata.packages_distributions. Falls back to predefined mappings for uninstalled packages and logs warnings if dynamic mapping fails.

functions.name: get_import_to_package_mapping
functions.description: Returns a cached mapping of import names to their corresponding pip package names, rebuilding the cache if requested. Integrates with build_dynamic_import_mapping to generate the mapping from system-level package data.

functions.name: list_installed_packages_tool
functions.description: Lists installed dependencies for specified or all supported programming languages in a project directory, outputting results in XML format. Integrates with pip, npm, go list, and Maven/Gradle build files to extract package information across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java projects.

functions.name: install_dependency_tool
functions.description: Installs a dependency for a specified programming language using a dependency manager, supporting Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, and Java with optional version and Python executable path overrides. Returns an XML-formatted result indicating status, package, language, message, and version, or an error if installation fails.

functions.name: search_pypi_tool
functions.description: Searches for a package on PyPI using the official JSON API and returns structured XML with package details, including name, version, summary, and install command. Falls back to search suggestions or error handling if the package is not found or an exception occurs.

functions.name: _search_pypi_suggestions
functions.description: Attempts to find similar PyPI package names based on a query using predefined mappings and common naming variations, returning XML-formatted suggestions or error messages. Integrates with external package naming patterns and provides hints for alternative installation attempts.

functions.name: is_mostly_russian
functions.description: Determines if a given text is predominantly in Russian based on the ratio of Cyrillic characters to total characters, using a configurable threshold. Integrates with regular expressions for character matching and handles edge cases like empty or whitespace-only input.

functions.name: _contains_only_code
functions.description: Determines if a text consists primarily of code based on specific syntax patterns and formatting, returning True if it should not be translated. Integrates with regex for pattern matching and handles edge cases like empty input.

functions.name: translate_to_russian
functions.description: Translates input text to Russian using Gemini 2.0 Flash with strict rules for preserving technical terms, code, and formatting, while handling long texts by splitting them. Integrates with LLM API via config settings and fallbacks to original text on failure or if translation is disabled.

functions.name: _translate_long_text
functions.description: Splits long text into manageable chunks by paragraphs or lines, then translates each chunk asynchronously using a provided context and length limit. Integrates with an external translation service via the translate_to_russian function, ensuring no chunk exceeds the specified maximum length.

functions.name: translate_sync
functions.description: Performs synchronous translation of text to Russian using an async translation function, handling event loop management across threads when necessary. Integrates with asyncio, logging, and includes fallbacks for empty, short, or code-containing text, with timeout and error handling.

functions.name: translate_cached
functions.description: Caches translated text for repeated short phrases using a synchronous translation function, improving performance for frequent translations like statuses or headers. Integrates with translate_sync for actual translation logic and leverages caching via functools.lru_cache.

functions.name: translate_thinking
functions.description: Translates an AI agent's internal reasoning about code analysis and problem solving into Russian. Optimized for technical context with asynchronous execution.

functions.name: translate_validator_verdict
functions.description: Translates an AI Validator's verdict into Russian using a context-aware translation service. Integrates with async translation functionality and relies on a predefined context for accurate terminology.

functions.name: translate_code_explanation
functions.description: Translates code explanations into Russian for use by a code generator. Integrates with a translation service using async I/O and context-aware translation.

functions.name: translate_analysis
functions.description: Translates orchestration analysis from English to Russian using a context-aware translation service. Integrates with an async translation backend and uses caching for performance.

functions.name: reset_translation_state
functions.description: Resets the translator's state by enabling translation and clearing the translation cache. Intended to be called when retrying translation after errors.

functions.name: test_translation
functions.description: Tests the translation system by attempting to translate a test string to Russian, verifying the result differs from the original and contains Russian characters. Integrates with the translate_to_russian function and uses is_mostly_russian for validation.

functions.name: check_translation_available
functions.description: Checks if translation functionality is available by validating configuration and required components without making API calls. Integrates with config.settings for provider and model validation, and uses app.llm.api_client for LLM integration.

functions.name: get_validation_logger
functions.description: Provides a session-specific validation logger, reusing the existing logger if the session ID matches.

functions.name: log_validation_error
functions.description: Logs validation errors with stage, exception, and optional context; uses a current logger if available or falls back to standard logging.

functions.name: _build_feedback_handling_block
functions.description: Generates a comprehensive feedback handling protocol for guiding code corrections, outlining step-by-step analysis, revision, and instruction refinement based on error types and feedback sources. Integrates structured output formatting, error classification (technical, staging, user, validator), and decision logic to ensure precise, actionable instructions for the code generator.

functions.name: get_feedback_loader
functions.description: Returns a singleton instance of FeedbackPromptLoader, initializing it if not already created. Integrates with global state to ensure consistent prompt loading across the application.

functions.name: reset_feedback_loader
functions.description: Resets the feedback loader to its initial state for a new session. Integrates with the global _FEEDBACK_LOADER instance to invoke its reset method.

functions.name: get_feedback_block_if_needed
functions.description: Returns a feedback block if validation errors are present, otherwise returns an empty string. Integrates with a feedback loader to dynamically retrieve feedback content based on error state.

functions.name: _get_parser
functions.description: Lazy-initializes a Tree-sitter parser for Python using the tree-sitter-python library, caching the parser and language instance for reuse. Integrates with logging for debug and warning messages during initialization.

functions.name: get_parser
functions.description: Returns a global instance of a fault-tolerant parser, initializing it if not already created. Integrates with Tree-sitter for robust syntax parsing with error recovery.

functions.name: get_multi_language_parser
functions.description: Returns a singleton instance of MultiLanguageParser, ensuring only one instance is created and reused. Integrates with tree-sitter for parsing multiple programming languages.

functions.name: parse
functions.description: Parses source code using a global parser instance, returning a ParseResult. Integrates with Tree-sitter for structured syntax analysis.

functions.name: find_class
functions.description: Finds a class by name within the provided source code using a Tree-sitter parser. Integrates with the parser's find_class method to return a parsed class representation or None if not found.

functions.name: find_method
functions.description: Finds a specific method within a class using a tree-sitter parser, returning parsed function details if found. Integrates with the tree-sitter parser for structured source code analysis.

functions.name: find_function
functions.description: Finds a function by name within the provided source code using a tree-sitter parser. Integrates with the parser's find_function method to return a parsed function object or None if not found.

functions.name: _get_extensions_for_language
functions.description: Returns a set of file extensions (including the dot) for a given programming language, or None if the language is not supported. Integrates with the LANGUAGE_EXTENSIONS dictionary to map language names to their respective file extensions.

functions.name: grep_search_tool
functions.description: Performs a grep-like search across project files with support for regex, case sensitivity, file patterns, and virtual file systems, automatically retrying literal searches as regex if metacharacters are detected. Integrates with a virtual file system and includes context lines, match limits, and intelligent expansion of search scope when no results are found.

functions.name: _collect_disk_files
functions.description: Collects files from the disk recursively within a given root directory, filtering by a specified file pattern or defaulting to text files, while respecting symlinks and excluding virtual file system files. Integrates with FileTypeDetector for file type validation and respects a maximum file limit to prevent excessive resource usage.

functions.name: _should_process_file
functions.description: Determines whether a file should be processed during a search by checking if it's a regular file, not a symlink, not excluded via VFS, and is a text-based file type. Integrates with FileTypeDetector to identify text files and uses project directory context for relative path resolution.

functions.name: _search_in_content
functions.description: Searches for a compiled regex pattern within file content, returning matched lines with surrounding context and total match count. Integrates with GrepMatch class to structure results and respects limits on matches per file and context lines.

functions.name: _search_in_content_multiline
functions.description: Searches for a compiled regex pattern in multiline file content, returning matched lines with surrounding context and line numbers. Integrates with pathlib for file path handling and uses bisect for efficient line offset mapping.

functions.name: _collect_files
functions.description: Collects files for search from both a virtual filesystem (VFS) and the local disk, prioritizing staged changes from VFS, applying filters for language extensions, file patterns, and text-based file types, with optional limits on the number of results. Integrates with a file type detector and supports path-based filtering using glob patterns.

functions.name: _search_in_files
functions.description: Performs a regex-based search across a list of files, optionally with multiline support, returning matching lines with context and counts. Integrates with file system I/O via pathlib and uses compiled regex patterns for efficient matching.

functions.name: _format_results
functions.description: Formats grep search results into an XML string with metadata, match details, and contextual lines, including notes when limits are exceeded. Integrates with file path handling and XML escaping to ensure safe output.

functions.name: _escape_xml
functions.description: Escapes XML special characters in a string to ensure safe XML output. Integrates with text processing workflows in grep_search.py for handling XML-formatted data.

functions.name: _format_error
functions.description: Formats an error message in a structured XML-like format for grep search operations, including a message and a troubleshooting suggestion. Integrates with error handling in file search workflows.

functions.name: show_file_relations_tool
functions.description: Analyzes and returns XML-formatted structural relationships of a file or specific element within it, supporting Python, JS/TS, Go, and Java. Integrates with a virtual filesystem for staged changes and includes options to filter test files, sibling files, and limit results.

functions.name: _analyze_file_relations
functions.description: Analyzes file relationships including imports, reverse imports, tests, siblings, and element-specific dependencies, leveraging a virtual file system for accurate project-wide navigation. Integrates with file content parsing, import extraction, and directory traversal utilities to build a comprehensive relation map.

functions.name: _read_file_content
functions.description: Reads file content from either a virtual file system (VFS) or the actual file system, using UTF-8 encoding. Integrates with pathlib.Path for path handling and supports fallback to physical file reading when VFS is not available.

functions.name: _extract_imports
functions.description: Extracts module import statements from file content across multiple programming languages including Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java, using regex patterns to identify import syntax. Returns a deduplicated list of imported modules while preserving the order of first appearance.

functions.name: _find_importers
functions.description: Finds files that import or use a given file by analyzing reverse dependencies across supported source files in a project. Integrates with a virtual filesystem to detect imports based on language-specific patterns and file content.

functions.name: _find_test_files
functions.description: Finds test files associated with a given source file using language-specific naming patterns and virtual file system integration. Supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java with configurable search paths and case-insensitive matching via a virtual file system.

functions.name: _find_sibling_files
functions.description: Finds all sibling files in the same directory as the given file path, either through a virtual file system or direct filesystem access, and returns up to 50 relative paths. Integrates with pathlib for path manipulation and logging for error handling.

functions.name: _detect_language
functions.description: Detects the programming language based on a file's extension, returning a standardized language name. Supports common extensions for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, and Java.

functions.name: _get_possible_import_names
functions.description: Generates possible import names or path fragments for a file based on its language-specific conventions, using file path, content, and directory structure. Integrates with a virtual filesystem to read file content and applies language-specific logic for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java.

functions.name: _file_imports_name
functions.description: Checks if a given content string contains an import or reference to a specified name/path for a specific programming language, using language-appropriate regex patterns. Supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java import syntax.

functions.name: _analyze_element_relations
functions.description: Analyzes dependencies and usages of a specific code element within a file, leveraging language-specific parsing and import analysis. Integrates with project-wide search to identify both external and internal dependencies, as well as all usages across the codebase.

functions.name: _find_element_usages
functions.description: Finds all project-wide usages of a specified class or method using language-aware regex patterns, leveraging a virtual filesystem for file access. Integrates with virtual_fs for file retrieval and supports multiple languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python.

functions.name: _format_relations
functions.description: Formats file relations into a structured XML string with proper escaping and metadata, including imports, imported-by references, tests, siblings, and optional element-level dependencies and usages. Integrates with XML escaping via _escape_xml and handles hierarchical data from a dictionary input.

functions.name: _format_error
functions.description: Formats an error message in XML format with a provided message and a suggestion to check the file path, escaping special XML characters. Integrates with _escape_xml function for safe XML output.

functions.name: _escape_xml
functions.description: Escapes special XML characters in a string to prevent parsing errors. Integrates with XML serialization by replacing reserved characters with their corresponding XML entities.

functions.name: build_go_context
functions.description: Constructs a contextual Go code snippet for AI processing by assembling package declarations, imports, and associated struct definitions when the target is a method. Integrates with GoChunk dataclass to organize and format code fragments with clear annotations.

functions.name: build_sql_context
functions.description: Builds a contextual SQL prompt for AI by combining the target SQL statement with its table schema when applicable. Integrates with a list of SQL chunks to retrieve and include corresponding CREATE TABLE definitions for DML operations.

functions.name: group_sql_by_table
functions.description: Groups SQL chunks by their associated table names for better organization and analysis of database operations. Handles unnamed statements by labeling them as '_misc_'.

functions.name: _get_syntax_fix_prompt
functions.description: Generates a language-specific system prompt for syntax fixing, falling back to a generic prompt if the language is not supported. Integrates with predefined prompt dictionaries (SYNTAX_FIX_PROMPTS and GENERIC_SYNTAX_FIX_PROMPT) for dynamic prompt selection.

functions.name: _build_user_message
functions.description: Constructs a structured, neutral user message for an LLM to fix code syntax and indentation, incorporating language, mode, target, errors, context, and formatting directives. Integrates with context information to guide code rewriting while enforcing strict output formatting via markers.

functions.name: extract_surrounding_context
functions.description: Extracts contextual code surrounding a target class, method, or function using Tree-sitter parsers for accurate syntax-aware context, with behavior tailored to modification mode (e.g., full method body for insertion, old code for replacement). Falls back to line-based context or first 30 lines if parsing fails or no structural target is found, ensuring fault-tolerant operation across multiple languages.

functions.name: _call_syntax_fixer
functions.description: Calls an LLM to fix syntax in a code block using either a direct model call or an internal A→A→B cascading fallback strategy, with support for multiple language contexts. Integrates with LLM API client and configuration settings, extracting fixed code via structured markers or fallback parsing.

functions.name: attempt_ai_syntax_fix
functions.description: Attempts to correct syntax in a code block using an AI-powered fixer, handling asyncio loop conflicts by offloading execution to a thread pool when necessary. Integrates with async coroutine _call_syntax_fixer and logs unexpected errors.

functions.name: attempt_ai_syntax_fix_with_retries
functions.description: Attempts to fix syntax errors in a code block using an AI-based fixer with up to a specified number of retries, ensuring the original code is always used for each attempt and avoiding repeated failed fixes. Integrates with logging for debugging and tracking, and includes anti-cascade protection to prevent accepting identical or unchanged fixes.

functions.name: list_files_tool
functions.description: Lists files and directories within a specified project directory, supporting recursive scanning, hidden file visibility, and integration with a virtual file system to include staged files. Returns an XML-formatted string with detailed file metadata, including type, path, size, modification time, and source (disk, VFS, or both).

functions.name: _should_ignore
functions.description: Checks if a file or directory name matches any pattern in IGNORE_PATTERNS using fnmatch for wildcard matching. Returns True if the name should be ignored, False otherwise.

functions.name: _validate_url
functions.description: Validates whether a given URL is safe and properly formatted, ensuring it uses HTTP or HTTPS and does not point to forbidden hosts like localhost or loopback addresses. Integrates with urlparse from the standard library for URL parsing and validation.

functions.name: _xml_escape
functions.description: Escapes special characters in a string to make it safe for inclusion in XML. Integrates with standard string handling and does not rely on external libraries beyond built-in Python modules.

functions.name: _absolutize_url
functions.description: Converts a relative URL to an absolute URL using the provided base URL, leveraging urljoin from urllib.parse. Integrates with URL parsing utilities to ensure correct path resolution.

functions.name: _fetch_html_internal
functions.description: Fetches HTML content from a URL with default headers and handles encoding detection, particularly fixing issues with non-UTF-8 encodings like Windows-1251. Integrates with httpx for HTTP requests and uses charset-normalizer to determine the correct text encoding from raw bytes.

functions.name: fetch_webpage_tool
functions.description: Fetches the raw HTML content of a webpage with optional length and timeout limits, returning it wrapped in XML-like tags with metadata. Handles errors gracefully and escapes special characters to ensure XML safety.

functions.name: analyze_webpage_tool
functions.description: Performs a comprehensive structural analysis of a webpage by extracting metadata, links, forms, media, and optional technology indicators, returning results in a structured XML format. Integrates with HTTPX for fetching web content and BeautifulSoup for parsing HTML, with support for configurable extraction limits and error handling.

functions.name: check_security_tool
functions.description: Evaluates the security posture of a website by checking HTTP security headers, HTTPS usage, cookie flags, and SSL certificate validity, returning a detailed XML report. Integrates with httpx for HTTP requests, ssl and socket for certificate inspection, and includes error handling for network and parsing issues.

functions.name: extract_media_tool
functions.description: Extracts URLs of images, videos, and audio files from a webpage using BeautifulSoup, with optional size checking via HTTP HEAD requests. Integrates with httpx for HTTP fetching and supports XML output formatting with absolute URL resolution.

functions.name: _escape_xml
functions.description: Escapes XML special characters in a given string to ensure safe XML representation. Integrates with XML parsing and generation workflows by converting reserved characters to their corresponding XML entities.

functions.name: _add_line_numbers
functions.description: Adds right-aligned line numbers to a list of strings, starting from a specified number. Integrates with logging for debugging and error tracking.

functions.name: read_line_context_tool
functions.description: Reads a file and returns context lines around a specified line number or text pattern, with support for virtual file systems and fallback to disk. Integrates path validation, error handling, and XML-formatted output with configurable context direction and line numbering.

functions.name: classify_staging_error
functions.description: Classifies staging errors from error messages into specific categories, prioritizing ast-grep-specific errors before handling legacy phrasing. Integrates with the feedback handler's StagingErrorType enum to ensure consistent error categorization, including fallbacks for unrecognized messages.

functions.name: _comment_block
functions.description: Modifies a list of code lines by prefixing a specified comment string to each line within a given range, preserving original indentation and leaving blank lines unchanged. Integrates with file processing logic to safely comment out code blocks without altering surrounding structure.

functions.name: _find_python_span_ast
functions.description: Finds the 1-based inclusive line span of a Python function, method, or class using the AST module for precise parsing, with support for nested or class-scoped targets. Integrates with logging for error handling and falls back to Tree-sitter if parsing fails.

functions.name: _find_span_tree_sitter
functions.description: Finds the 1-based inclusive line span of a named element in code using Tree-sitter parsing, returning None if the element is not found or lacks line information. Integrates with MultiLanguageParser for language-specific syntax tree traversal and handles fallbacks for varying API signatures.

functions.name: comment_out_element
functions.description: Comments out a specified function, method, or class in a file by wrapping its lines in language-specific comments, using either Python's AST or Tree-sitter for parsing, with fallback support for multiple file types. Integrates with a MultiLanguageParser for non-Python files and logs the operation.

functions.name: analyze_state
functions.description: Analyzes the current code content against expected new and old versions to determine if it matches the new code, old code, or represents a mutation, normalizing line endings and using difflib for precise difference calculation. Returns a diagnostic string indicating the state and size of the content, along with character-level change statistics for mutations.

functions.name: print_content_preview
functions.description: Prints a preview of the first 300 characters of a given content string, enclosed in separators for clarity. Used for debugging or logging to quickly inspect large content snippets.

functions.name: run_test
functions.description: Runs a comprehensive test of a code staging and validation pipeline with mocked AI validation, simulating code changes, staging, and multiple validation stages while monitoring file state changes. Integrates with virtual file system (VFS), validation modules, and feedback loops to verify correct behavior under test conditions.

functions.name: translate_tester_report
functions.description: Translates a tester report from English to Russian using Gemini Flash Lite with a 25-second timeout, returning the original text if translation fails or the report is already mostly in Russian. Integrates with asyncio for asynchronous execution and uses logger for error and timeout tracking.

functions.name: _translate_with_gemini_flash_lite
functions.description: Translates technical testing reports to Russian using the Gemini Flash Lite model while preserving code elements, technical terms, and markdown formatting. Integrates with LLM API via call_llm and uses configuration-driven model selection.

functions.name: get_intermediate_model
functions.description: Selects an appropriate model for an intermediate agent based on available providers and a preferred provider, using a defined priority order and fallbacks. Returns the model ID and reasoning effort, with a special "disabled" sentinel if thinking is disabled for the model and no explicit reasoning effort is configured.

functions.name: get_orchestrator_model_for_agent
functions.description: Selects an orchestrator-tier model for agents requiring high-level intelligence by prioritizing specific providers and falling back to others, returning the first available model ID. Integrates with config.provider_models to retrieve model lists based on provider and role.

functions.name: get_generator_model_for_agent
functions.description: Selects a generator-tier model for the code_generator agent based on provider priority and availability, using model lists from config.provider_models. Returns the first available model ID with None for reasoning_effort, falling back to non-priority providers if no priority provider has a valid model.

functions.name: get_role_models
functions.description: Returns a list of model tuples (id, name, description) for a specified provider and role, filtering by predefined model IDs for orchestrator or generator roles. Includes a safety net to assign unclassified models to the orchestrator role by default.
